title: Impact of Analyst Coverage on Firm Investment

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy
The appropriate causal method for this analysis is Instrumental Variables (IV) regression. In this context, the broker mergers (z) provide an exogenous source of variation in analyst coverage (x), which allows us to identify the causal effect of analyst coverage on firm investment (y). The key assumption is that the instrument (broker merger) affects firm investment only through its impact on analyst coverage and not through any other channel (exclusion restriction).

## 2. R Code
```r
# Load necessary libraries
library(AER)  # for ivreg function

# Read the dataset
data_path <- "experiments/exp_b/data/s71_data.csv"
data <- read.csv(data_path)

# Define the model
# First stage regression: regressing x (analyst coverage) on the instrument (z) and controls
first_stage <- lm(x ~ z + controls, data = data)
summary(first_stage)

# Second stage regression: using the predicted x from the first stage to assess impact on y
iv_model <- ivreg(y ~ x + controls | z + controls, data = data)
iv_summary <- summary(iv_model)

# Print the results
cat("IV Regression Results:\n")
print(iv_summary$coefficients)

# Robustness checks: Check if the instrument is strong
first_stage_fstat <- summary(first_stage)$fstatistic[1]
cat("First Stage F-statistic: ", first_stage_fstat, "\n")

# Check for weak instrument (rule of thumb: first stage F-statistic should be > 10)
if(first_stage_fstat > 10) {
  cat("Instrument appears to be strong.\n")
} else {
  cat("Warning: Instrument might be weak.\n")
}
```

## 3. Expected Findings
I expect the sign of the coefficient for analyst coverage on firm investment to be positive, suggesting that increased analyst coverage due to broker mergers leads to higher firm investment. Analyst coverage likely reduces information asymmetry, which can lower the cost of capital or improve firm management's confidence, thus increasing investment. The magnitude might be modest but significant if the instrument is strong and valid.

_ground_truth.identification_strategy: Use broker mergers as an instrument for analyst coverage.
_ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Increased analyst coverage significantly boosts firm investment.
